messages:
jess_customer: Hey team — signed up ~30m ago, completed email verify and Apple Pay flow, but I don't see my free trial credits. Account email jess+trial@example.com. Any ideas?

maria_support: Hi Jess :wave: sorry about that. Can you confirm the country you signed up from and the device (iPhone/Android/web)?

jess_customer: I signed up from an iPhone in Spain (ES). Apple Pay on my iPhone. Tried the signup in Chrome mobile.

maria_support: Thanks. Two quick checks: is the payment method listed under Settings -> Billing? and did you get a 3DS flow or any popup during Apple Pay?

jess_customer: In Billing it shows Apple Pay (masked), no 3DS popup I remember. The card is a UK-issued card (BIN country GB) but billing address is Spain.

maria_support: Ok that helps. Sometimes we gate trial grants when BIN country and signup region mismatch or when Apple Pay doesn't surface BIN to us. I'll check logs. Can you hold for a few? :thumbsup:

billing-bot: [system] Retrieved account events for jess+trial@example.com: signup=1805554308, email_verify=1805554315, payment_method_added=1805554320, trial_grant_attempt=1805554323 -> gated_by_payment_review.

maria_support: Looks like the trial grant attempted but hit payment_review gating (BIN/region mismatch). I can escalate to payments for manual review. Leo, any notes on Apple Pay BIN visibility for EU signups? @leo_payments

leo_payments: Apple Pay tokenization often hides BIN and we only see token metadata. If BIN country != signup_region we sometimes flag for manual review until we fetch more info or risk fraud. If the customer completed 3DS we usually auto-release. In this case no 3DS occurred so it stayed gated.

maria_support: Thanks Leo. Jess — I can submit a manual review and, if cleared, manually grant the trial credits (1000 free tokens). Would you like me to proceed?

jess_customer: Yes please, that'd be great. I need it to test embeddings.

maria_support: Submitting now. Internal note: request manual trial grant for account jess+trial@example.com — reason: Apple Pay tokenization hid BIN, card BIN country GB vs signup region ES, user verified email. cc @leo_payments @sam_engineer

sam_engineer: Added a quick check to the grant flow to log tokenization metadata for Apple Pay (will ship to staging). For now we'll do manual grant.

leo_payments: Done with quick review — no fraud signals. Maria, please apply manual trial grant of 1000 credits and set account flag trial_manual_grant=true.

maria_support: Grant applied — 1000 trial credits now visible on account. Jess, can you confirm you see them in Console -> Billing?

jess_customer: Confirmed! I see 1,000 trial tokens and the embeddings request works. Thanks everyone :tada:

maria_support: Great — marking resolved. For the product team notes: consider relaxing gating for Apple Pay when email_verified=true and tokenization metadata present. Filed follow-up ticket: https://redwood.example.com/ops/tickets/INC-4768

sam_engineer: Filing a small telemetry task to capture Apple Pay token fields (non-PII) to reduce manual reviews.

maria_support: Closing thread. If anything else pops up feel free to reopen. :mag:
